affectedCopies: McpApiToken rows of kind workroom_session, issued and revoked only by the Workroom runtime supervisor (apps/web/lib/workroom-runtime/session-credential.ts)
Read by resolveWorkroomSessionToken on every MCP call that presents such a token, and by the existing admin token list

privacyAssessment.sensitivity: internal: a Workroom semantic id (WC-*) and a TaskRun id; no names, contact data or secrets (the token secret stays hashed as for every McpApiToken)
privacyAssessment.dataSubjectRights: No new personal content; the row is owned by the user the room acts for, as every McpApiToken is.
privacyAssessment.reviewDisposition: Rows follow McpApiToken's existing lifecycle: revoked on session stop, expire after 24 hours idle, and cascade with their user.

migration.name: 20261014090000_workroom_session_credential
migration.backfill: None: two nullable columns and a plain index, added with IF NOT EXISTS. Existing rows read NULL and behave as before.
migration.rollback: Forward-only. Older code ignores the columns; rollback means reverting the code, never dropping them.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Existing model; the new columns follow the row and add no retention obligation.

fields.reason: The Workroom (capsuleId) a workroom_session token is bound to; the MCP route refuses the token for any other room.
The TaskRun the session works for, when there is one; carried to governed execution as the call's taskRunId.
